key_findings: scripts/ is a flat directory of ~60 standalone Python files (top-level, not a package) plus three subdirs: scripts/benchmarks/ (2 files: brian2 vs jaxfne Izhikevich comparison), scripts/evidence_figures/ (19 files: fig0X architecture/backend/scaling figures + ed0X evidence-receipt generators, verified via `ls scripts/evidence_figures/*.py | wc -l`), and scripts/release/ (4 files: assert_release_freeze.py, reconcile_release_target.py, validate_release_artifacts.py, print_tag_receipt.sh).

Purpose split: (1) evidence/release-receipt generation (ed*, fig*, evidence_inventory.py, evidence_figures_inventory.py), (2) HDP/homeostasis sweep and workflow scripts (hdp_*.py, ed9/ed10 files, sphere20_ei_hdp_habituation.py, cortical_column_localized_workflow.py), (3) audit/CI-gate scripts invoked by name from AGENTS.md and skills (audit_public_docs_language.py, audit_notebooks_and_assets.py, validate_json_safe.py, snapshot_public_api.py, report_hygiene_check.py, check_docs_orphans.py), (4) shared library modules imported by skills/other scripts but not run directly: scripts/hash_utils.py (SHA256 helpers backing jaxfne-sha256-artifact-integrity skill) and underscore-prefixed private helpers scripts/_ed9_common.py, scripts/_neuron_sweep_common.py, scripts/evidence_figures/_figure_common.py.

Deliberate, documented exception to the jaxfne-modular-grammar vis rule: scripts/evidence_figures/*.py call matplotlib/plotly directly instead of routing through jaxfne/vis/* -- explicitly reconsidered and reaffirmed as correct design (FRICTIONS_STACK F-026, closed 2026-07-08); scripts/evidence_figures/README.md documents the same carve-out. The matplotlib save/close path still routes through jaxfne/vis/evidence_export.py::save_matplotlib_figure and jaxfne/vis/evidence_manifest.py.
scripts/audit_public_docs_language.py --check is wired into CI and referenced directly from AGENTS.md line 63 as the doc-language guard.

scripts/spectrolaminar_tfne_izhikevich_pipeline.py deliberately bypasses HDPColumnConfig/hdp_network.build_model() and uses the lower-level Configuration.laminar_cortex_config()/.area_layer_cell_types() builder directly, because its 5-layer (merged L2/3) + flat cell-type-fraction shape doesn't fit HDPColumnConfig's canonical 6-layer per-layer-fraction schema -- documented as intentional (FRICTIONS_STACK F-023, closed 2026-07-03), not a migration gap.

scripts/cortical_column_localized_workflow.py::save_column/load_column is the fix site for a real pytree-treedef corruption bug (F-020): IzhikevichParams/EdgeList treedef aux data is N-size-dependent, so reload must reconstruct dataclasses directly from persisted labels/layer_labels/calibration/cfg.metadata rather than via a dummy-treedef jax.tree_util.tree_unflatten shortcut.

scripts/sphere20_ei_hdp_habituation.py is the reproduction case for F-031: construct()'s default dense same-area recurrent wiring (_suite2_apply_connectivity in jaxfne/_construct.py) silently layers on top of explicit NeuronalTensor-bridged InterConnection edges unless neutralized with cfg.connectivity(within_area=..., within_gain=0.0) before construct().
contracts: scripts/hash_utils.py exports sha256_file, stable_json_bytes, sha256_json (and per jaxfne-sha256-artifact-integrity/SKILL.md lines 83-244, candidate_sha256 and load_weight_artifact) -- canonical hashing helpers; the skill explicitly says import them rather than reimplementing.
scripts/audit_public_docs_language.py supports a `--check` CLI flag used by CI (AGENTS.md:63).

scripts/release/assert_release_freeze.py: reads AGENTS.md and/or .release_target.json for freeze state; exit 0 = freeze inactive or all SHA invariants hold, exit 1 = freeze active and an invariant violated, exit 2 = freeze state undeterminable (verified from its own docstring, lines 1-20).

Full pre-release validation sequence from jaxfne-notebook-release-gate/SKILL.md lines 80-85: `python -m compileall -q jaxfne tests examples scripts`, `pytest tests/ -q --tb=line`, `python scripts/audit_notebooks_and_assets.py --check`, `mkdocs build --strict`, plus a smoke nbconvert execute -- scripts/ is compiled and gated as part of this chain.

Underscore-prefixed files (scripts/_ed9_common.py, scripts/_neuron_sweep_common.py, scripts/evidence_figures/_figure_common.py) are shared-helper modules meant to be imported by sibling scripts, not run standalone.

scripts/evidence_figures/README.md is the authoritative in-repo statement of the vis-grammar exception for that subdirectory; cite it rather than re-deriving when auditing whether evidence_figures/ should migrate into jaxfne/vis/.
landmines: Do not 'fix' scripts/evidence_figures/*.py's direct matplotlib/plotly calls as a grammar violation -- explicitly reviewed and closed as intentional (FRICTIONS_STACK F-026); re-flagging wastes a pass.

Do not attempt to migrate scripts/spectrolaminar_tfne_izhikevich_pipeline.py onto HDPColumnConfig/hdp_network.build_model() -- closed as intentional non-consolidation (F-023); its layer/fraction shape is genuinely outside HDPColumnConfig's scope.

Any script that saves/reloads a constructed Model/Configuration via jax.tree_util pytree machinery must NOT rely on a differently-sized dummy-construct() treedef for reconstruction -- silently produces a wrong-but-finite result, no error (F-020); scripts/cortical_column_localized_workflow.py shows the correct pattern (explicit field persistence + direct dataclass reconstruction).

Any script bridging a NeuronalTensor (via neuronal_tensor_to_configuration) that then calls construct() must null out construct()'s default same-area dense recurrent generator (cfg.connectivity(within_area=..., within_gain=0.0)) or edges silently double-wire on top of explicit InterConnection edges (F-031).

The generic 'I' (Inhibitory) cell-type shorthand used across scripts/evidence_figures/ (and examples/, tests/) previously silently fell back to VIP parameters via a masked fallback in jaxfne/emitters.py::_get_cell_type_params; closed by adding 'I' as an explicit VIP alias (F-028) rather than raising -- only 5 keys are ever valid repo-wide for cell_type dict literals: E, I, PV, SST, VIP.
